description: The chart represents the distribution of various categories within the Darija Open Dataset, Version 2. The donut chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories are labeled in a legend to the right of the chart and are colored differently: Moroccan Names (orange), Semantic Categories (purple), Syntactic Roles (brown), Translated Sentences (yellow), Extra + Augmented Data (blue), and Pending Translations (green). The slices are labeled with their corresponding numerical values, showing that Translated Sentences (yellow) comprise the largest portion at 45,387, followed by Pending Translations (green) at 43,000, and Extra + Augmented Data (blue) at 30,000, while Syntactic Roles (brown) make up 23,108. The remaining two categories, Semantic Categories (purple) and Moroccan Names (orange), are significantly smaller. The chart includes a legend and numerical labels inside the slices, with no slices visually emphasized. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, starting from the top, with the largest slice, Translated Sentences, positioned at the bottom right.
